channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-130719 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated shared-base link holders to read the base's stored plaintext password through the general base metadata endpoint. Attackers with a share link can query the base read or list responses in bases.controller.ts, which skip password stripping in sanitizeBase.ts, to obtain reusable plaintext passwords.

item.title: CVE-2026-130720 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access records hidden by a shared view's row filter by supplying arbitrary primary keys. Attackers with the share link can request attachment downloads and many-to-many or has-many link listings for excluded records to obtain their attachment files and linked record identities.

item.title: CVE-2026-130721 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2 | NocoDB from 2026.06.2 before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated base Editors to write to data-read-only sources by abusing the internal batch endpoint. Attackers can name a writable decoy table on the batch envelope and target a read-only source table in dataUpdate, dataInsert or dataDelete sub-operations to modify or destroy records.

item.title: CVE-2026-130722 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass in shared-view relation endpoints because parent-record lookups apply only the primary key, not the view's row filter. Anonymous share-link holders can enumerate auto-increment primary keys against the has-many, many-to-many, one-to-many and link-to-another-record routes to read linked records of filtered-out rows.

item.title: CVE-2026-130723 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access attachments of filtered-out records through the shared view attachment-download endpoint. Attackers holding a public share link can enumerate sequential primary keys to obtain signed download paths for files on records the view's row filter excludes.

item.title: CVE-2026-130724 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4 | NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated base Editors to make backend HTTP requests by supplying arbitrary URLs to the integration remote fetch operation. Attackers can control the method, headers, and body to reach internal APIs, loopback services, and cloud metadata endpoints, reading responses and echoed decrypted integration secrets.

item.title: CVE-2026-130725 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | NocoDB before 2026.10.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to obtain signed download URLs for other bases' attachments by storing foreign attachment paths in their own rows via prepareNocoData. Attackers with write access to an attachment column can have _convertAttachmentType or the attachment download endpoint sign the foreign path, reading cross-base files despite secure attachment mode.

item.title: CVE-2026-130726 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.0
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.0 | NocoDB before 2026.07.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in its MySQL and SQLite clients that inserts the column precision value into generated data-definition statements without numeric validation. Authenticated users with the Creator or Owner base role can supply a crafted precision value when creating or updating a column to close the type declaration and execute arbitrary SQL against the base's data source.

item.title: CVE-2026-130727 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in public shared-view endpoints that fetch records by primary key without applying the view's row filter. Anonymous share link holders can enumerate sequential primary keys on link, has-many, and attachment download endpoints to read excluded records' linked data and download their attachments.

item.title: CVE-2026-130728 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to register OAuth clients with javascript: redirect URIs. Attackers can send a consent link to a signed-in victim so either consent button runs script in the NocoDB origin, stealing the session token for account takeover.

item.title: CVE-2026-130729 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass in its public shared-view relation endpoints, which verify that a parent record exists but not that it passes the view's row filters. Unauthenticated attackers holding a public share link can supply guessable auto-incrementing ids of filtered-out records to has-many, many-to-many, one-many, or link endpoints to read their child records.

item.title: CVE-2026-130730 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows OAuth token holders to act as full sessions because OAuth access tokens are signed with the instance JWT secret. Attackers can present a narrowly scoped OAuth token to the session strategy, short-lived-token exchange, or NocoSocket handshake to gain the granting user's full privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-130731 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6 | NocoDB before 2026.05.3 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows invited users to complete other invitees' signups because batch invitations share one token across all recipients. Attackers holding a valid batch invite can submit another invitee's email with the shared non-expiring token to set its password and take over that account, including higher-role ones.

item.title: CVE-2026-130732 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Traefik from 2.11.58 before 2.11.61 contains a resource leak vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust resources by sending Authorization headers with NTLM or Negotiate schemes. Attackers can open many short-lived connections that each allocate a dedicated backend transport never released, exhausting memory, file descriptors and backend connections.

item.title: CVE-2026-130733 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows publishers to overwrite pages their per-page permissions deny by abusing FolderStorage key delimiter collisions and PageStorage folder reconstruction. Attackers can rename a folder like locked*** or save from a page with an unusual prefix width through a front-end Flex pages form, replacing protected content and permissions to access the protected subtree.

item.title: CVE-2026-130734 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with media upload rights to bypass the upload sanitizer. Attackers can upload SVG files with inner extensions like .svg.defaults, payloads that crash the fail-open sanitizer, or unblocked .xml/.xhtm files to run script when administrators open the raw file URL.

item.title: CVE-2026-130735 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a Twig injection vulnerability that allows media-only accounts and anonymous uploaders to execute Twig by placing delimiters in image titles, alt text, class, id, or file names. Attackers can combine injected Twig with the autoescape tag to serve script to every page visitor, including super admins, or expose unpublished page content.

item.title: CVE-2026-130736 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows publishers to bypass the media action allowlist using scoped method names in Markdown image URLs. Attackers can chain actions like self::addMetaFile into static calls such as Process::fromShellCommandline to read files and run shell commands as the web server user.

item.title: CVE-2026-130737 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows user managers to grant super-admin rights by nesting access maps under a YAML merge key. Attackers with admin.users.create or api.users.write can submit '<<' keys, for example via PATCH /api/v1/users/<self>, that bypass super-grant filtering and gain full site control.

item.title: CVE-2026-130738 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows user managers with admin.users.update to take over super admin accounts by disabling the super-granting group. Attackers can set the group's enabled field to false via the Flex user-groups form, then reset the victim's password through the user-accounts form to gain super admin access.

item.title: CVE-2026-130739 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows user managers and Flex editors to overwrite, create, or delete accounts by supplying client-controlled storage keys. Attackers can abuse the create form username, cross-type form flash replay, or __META storage key rename to gain super-admin accounts or delete account files.

item.title: CVE-2026-130740 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows publishers and read-only user managers to read password hashes, 2FA secrets and reset tokens through unfiltered account serialization. Attackers can embed a Flex form for the user-accounts directory in a page or query the Flex API with admin.users.read to obtain super admin credentials and take over the account.

item.title: CVE-2026-130741 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a Twig sandbox bypass vulnerability that allows publishers to read any server file by abusing allowlisted array_key_value() and page accessor setters such as filePath(). Attackers can repoint page objects or overwrite the assets collections to render private keys and the API signing secret, then forge a super-admin API token.

item.title: CVE-2026-130742 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 resolves Flex sort and filter field names by first calling them as public methods, so a field named delete invokes FlexObject::delete() without any permission check. Authenticated users with only list access can send GET /api/v1/flex-objects/user-accounts?sort=delete requests to delete every account, then use the reopened API first-run setup to create a super admin.

item.title: CVE-2026-130743 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an insecure blueprint trust vulnerability that allows publisher accounts to read secrets and execute PHP by planting or selecting attacker-controlled blueprint files. Attackers can abuse the import@ directive, uploaded YAML media named as the page template, or form.flash_folder to leak password hashes and keys or invoke static PHP methods for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-130744 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows page editors to escape the Twig sandbox by sending requests with a Host: pages header. Attackers can write configuration YAML through page folders and media .meta.yaml sidecars to register an unsandboxed Twig namespace and run shell commands as the web server user.

item.title: CVE-2026-130745 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous visitors to read protected pages because admin and site scopes share a page cache key. Routine editor activity through the API plugin rebuilds the page index without frontmatter.yaml access rules, exposing members-only page content until the cache is rebuilt.

item.title: CVE-2026-130746 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7 | Grav before 1.7.53.7 and 2.x before 2.2.18 serves page media files, and rendered pages when lazy sessions are enabled, with the visitor's session cookie and a shared-cacheable Cache-Control header. When a shared cache such as Apache mod_cache stores Set-Cookie responses, an attacker can lure a user signed in through the front-end login to open a media URL with a unique query string, then request that URL to receive the cached session cookie and take over the session.

item.title: CVE-2026-130747 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2 | Grav before 1.7.53.7 and 2.x before 2.2.18 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows anonymous visitors to create super-admin accounts because UserCollection::count() uses an unescaped glob() pattern. On installs whose path contains brackets or a backslash, the account count returns zero, so attackers can send requests to POST /api/v1/auth/setup or the classic admin registration form to create or overwrite administrator accounts.

item.title: CVE-2026-130748 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability that allows anonymous attackers to redirect reset links by forging the CloudFront-Forwarded-Proto header. Attackers can send a forgot-password request with a crafted scheme value so the emailed reset link points to their host, capturing the token to take over accounts including super admins.

item.title: CVE-2026-130749 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to fill the disk by varying the HTTP Host header. Attackers can send requests with distinct Host values to create per-host compiled configuration, blueprint, language and page index caches, causing session, upload and logging failures.

item.title: CVE-2026-132079 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description:
Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy Go SDK. The TCP client method CreatePersonalAccessToken wrote the 32-bit expiry into the upper half of the 64-bit expiry field that the server reads. The server read a nonzero expiry as 2^32 times the requested value. A token created through the Go TCP client therefore stayed valid about four billion times longer than the caller asked for.
This issue affects Apache Iggy Go SDK: from 0.5.0 before 0.10.0.
Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue. Tokens that an earlier version created keep their long expiry on the server. Delete those tokens and create new ones.

item.title: CVE-2026-82951 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Latvijas Valsts radio un televīzijas centrs (LVRTC) eParakstītājs 3.0 version 1.10.0-resolute allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause HTTP GET requests from a user's workstation by convincing the user to open a crafted signed eDOC file. Automatic certificate validation retrieves a signer-controlled Authority Information Access (AIA) caIssuers URL and follows redirects without restricting the destination, enabling blind SSRF to loopback and private-network services. Additionally, unrestricted loading of local file URIs (such as file:///dev/zero) causes unbounded memory buffering resulting in Denial of Service (OutOfMemoryError). In automated server verification pipelines with UI:N, impact scales up to CVSS 8.6 High.

item.title: CVE-2026-82952 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Latvijas Valsts radio un televīzijas centrs (LVRTC) eParakstītājs 3.0 version 1.10.0-resolute for Linux allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the current user by convincing the user to open and validate a signed PDF with a crafted filename and select Open with Adobe Reader. The application embeds the filename in a sh -c command without neutralizing shell command substitution.

item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | A DANE-enabled TLS client may crash by dereferencing a NULL pointer when processing an unusual combination of certificate and TLSA records.

item.title: CVE-2026-92236 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1 | The Asset CleanUp: Page Speed Booster plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via 'wpacu_unload_css' and 'wpacu_unload_js' Query Parameters in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.0.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link. Successful exploitation requires that the victim has sufficient privileges to see the plugin's admin-bar entry, typically an administrator.

item.title: CVE-2026-95690 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | Receiving crafted out-of-sequence DTLS handshake fragments may cause OpenSSL to allocate a full message-length reassembly buffer for each buffered message, so a small amount of wire data consumes a large amount of memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-96571 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 18 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The FancyBox for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Anchor 'href' Attribute in all versions up to, and including, 3.4.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the attacker to wrap the payload anchor around a smilie shortcode (e.g., :mrgreen:), which WordPress renders as an <img> element, satisfying the plugin's a:has(img) enrollment selector and disguising the malicious link as an ordinary comment emoticon.
